method: each guard is removed in a COPY inside a run-owned sandbox; the production tree is hashed before and after and was not modified

results.mutation: the missing-marker refusal is replaced by an affirmative result
results.observation: the F1 control now passes a directory with no ownership record, so the guard is load-bearing

results.guard: a marker naming a different root refuses
results.observation: the F2 control now accepts a marker that names another directory, so the guard is load-bearing
the F8 control now lets a superseded record authorize disposal, so the guard is load-bearing

results.guard: a substituted object refuses even when its marker is a valid copy
results.mutation: the identity comparison is replaced by a weak pass
results.observation: the F4A control now accepts a replaced object carrying a copied valid marker, so the identity guard is the only thing that caught it and is load-bearing

results.guard: the object at the quarantine name is re-verified before deletion
results.mutation: a substitution is injected at the exact point the identity re-check reads the object
results.observation: the mutant deleted a foreign directory substituted at the quarantine name, so the re-check is load-bearing

results.guard: a junction at a declared name outside the source tree is refused
results.mutation: the destination classification in the extra loop is removed
results.observation: the sharing case-4/5 control now admits a dangling junction, so the guard is load-bearing

results.guard: a declared directory whose content does not match the expected install is refused
results.observation: the sharing case-3 control now admits content that does not match the install, so the guard is load-bearing

results.guard: cleaned=true requires the quarantine name to be observed absent
results.mutation: the post-removal existence check is deleted, and the removal is made a no-op that reports success
results.observation: the mutant reported a completed disposal while the object was still on disk, so the observation check is load-bearing

evidence.note: the baseline arm ran WITHOUT the no-op injection, so it disposes normally; the mutant arm is the one that measures the check
